title: Language-aware token surface filter prevents wrong-language popup lookups
trigger: Tokenizer emits words from multiple languages on a mixed-language page; users can click and look up Vietnamese/French/etc. words while the extension is set to English.
principle: At tokenization time, validate each token surface against the target language's allowed character set. Do not emit tokens that cannot belong to the target language, so wrong-language words never become clickable and never trigger dictionary popups. Use BCP-47-aware language matching for langCode subtags and keep the check deterministic and fast (e.g., an ASCII regex for English). Document the ceiling: unmarked words that share the target alphabet (e.g. Vietnamese 'gia' in English mode) still pass because single-token script detection is ambiguous.

cases.context: English-mode tokenize on a mixed English/Vietnamese page produces 'dai', 'gia', 'dinh' tokens and users click them expecting English definitions.

applyFor: Dictionary lookup triggers on web pages or subtitles
Filtering mixed-language content in content scripts
Lightweight language gating when full n-gram detection is too expensive
